title: Associate Account Director (Medical Communications & Marketing)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><p>Real Chemistry is a global health innovation company with offices across EMEA, APAC and the US. We believe that the way to real, transformative change is through the uncommon combination of disciplines, technologies, and our greatest asset – our people. We are currently looking to add to our alchemic mix of more than 1,800 talented professionals. This is a great opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing global company committed to making the world a healthier place for all.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Job Summary</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Real Chemistry Germany </strong>is&nbsp;looking for a strong <strong>Associate Account Director</strong> to join our team, acting as the day-to-day account lead across accounts in medical affairs, marketing and comms. You will be managing client relationships, taking responsibility for the delivery of projects, and identifying areas for growth within your accounts.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are an established global business with a new offering in the German market, so need someone who is confident, proactive, happy to work autonomously when needed but also as part of a growing global team, and happy to get stuck in!</p> <p>For this role you will be working on global and local market accounts so we will require someone fluent in both German and English.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Job Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the lead on your assigned accounts</li> <li>Liaising with clients and acting as point of contact</li> <li>Taking responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account including budgets, timelines and forecasting</li> <li>Working cross-functionally with creative, strategy, and content teams across Real Chemistry Germany but also the wider EMEA and Global teams</li> <li>Identifying areas for growth across your accounts and working with senior leadership to build on these areas</li> <li>Taking an active role in new business development, supporting the senior team with proposals and pitches</li> <li>Supporting the junior team, providing mentorship and guidance</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Skills &amp; Experience</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Already working as an Associate Account Director or at Senior Account Manager level</li> <li>Experience within a medical communications or health marketing agency</li> <li>Experience working with pharmaceutical clients</li> <li>Experience working across both local market (Germany and/or DACH) and Global accounts</li> <li>A fluent German and English speaker</li> <li>Proactive, driven, and resourceful&nbsp;</li> <li>Highly organised self-starter, able to work independently but also across a global team</li> <li>You have excellent business communication abilities, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work®&nbsp;certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile&nbsp;<u><a href="https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2Fcertified-company%2F7038366&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cclehmar%40realchemistry.com%7C1f18aaed4326491b3efc08ddd690f025%7C6fa5bfc4f95843f8bb395d382689654b%7C0%7C0%7C638902640185888156%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=pwvaCn37QXkjVQ0p6u92Oz4FA4j5NQZoNJL0ffy01qs%3D&amp;reserved=0">here</a>.</u></p> <p>We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support&nbsp;and&nbsp;access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.&nbsp;&nbsp;Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at:&nbsp;<a href="https://www.realchemistrybenefits.com">www.realchemistrybenefits.com</a>.</p> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate.&nbsp;</span>Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey.&nbsp;For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities.&nbsp;While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.</p> <p>Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.</p> <p>*Notice: Real Chemistry and its affiliates' names are being misused by scammers through messaging services, fake websites, and apps. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more&nbsp;<u><a href="https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.realchemistry.com%2Fscam-alert&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cclehmar%40realchemistry.com%7C1f18aaed4326491b3efc08ddd690f025%7C6fa5bfc4f95843f8bb395d382689654b%7C0%7C0%7C638902640185967986%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=vBa1KYjD6TUHgTF3FdPRQZvM8E8WUgHZqu9yHevh1%2BI%3D&amp;reserved=0">here</a></u>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.&nbsp; We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. title: Engineering Manager - Customer Developer Experience
description: About Constructor Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the Role As an Engineering Manager on the Customer Developer Experience (CDX) team, you'll lead engineers whose work spans two fronts: partnering directly with the external developers integrating our platform to provide hands-on technical guidance, and building the advanced open-source tooling that makes those integrations effortless. Constructor’s open source technology is utilized on millions of end user devices and are crucial to powering the most innovative product discovery experiences in the industry. You'll set the technical strategy for our open-source tooling and how it advances the experience of the external developers who build on our platform. Keeping their trust means keeping our libraries reliable, high-quality, and well-documented, and that ownership sits with you. Challenges you will tackle Cross functional collaboration and prioritization: close collaboration with product, customer success, data science and other engineering teams to prioritize features and address customer needs effectively. Balancing support and delivery : allocating the team's capacity across hands-on integration support and long-term tooling development, so that neither the customers in front of you nor the platform work that scales the whole business gets starved. Recruiting and hiring : owning the hiring process for your team end to end, from building a strong pipeline to running an effective interview loop and closing the engineers you want. Du möchtest mit deiner Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegen? Bei Swisio entwickeln wir eine der führenden SaaS-Cloud-Lösungen für Workforce Management, Dienst- und Personalplanung – und helfen Krankenhäusern und Pflegeeinrichtungen dabei, den Arbeitsalltag für tausende Menschen zu verbessern.

Das Beste aus zwei Welten:
Bei uns erlebst du die Dynamik, Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurzen Entscheidungswege eines Start-ups – kombiniert mit der Sicherheit einer profitablen Muttergesellschaft aus den Niederlanden, die seit über 20 Jahren nachhaltig erfolgreich am Markt ist.
So können wir uns voll auf Innovation und nachhaltiges Wachstum konzentrieren – ohne Abhängigkeit von externen Investoren.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt einzusteigen:
Wir befinden uns in einer starken Expansionsphase in Deutschland und der Schweiz. Bereits heute arbeiten renommierte Einrichtungen wie große Universitätskliniken und Krankenhausverbände mit uns – und das Wachstumspotenzial allein im DACH-Gesundheitsmarkt ist enorm.
Mittelfristig werden wir unsere bewährten Lösungen auch in andere Branchen bringen – in den Niederlanden setzen bereits Unternehmen wie Mars, DHL, der Holländische Staat und Tata Steel auf unsere Technologie. Als Teil unseres Teams gestaltest du diese Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mit.

Dein Impact

  • Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unseres InPlanning-Platforms und seiner Features. 

  • Analyse komplexer Szenarien, Erarbeitung von Lösungsansätzen und deren Umsetzung in Code. 

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und dem internen Team, um Anforderungen in technische Lösungen zu überführen. 

  • Realisierung technischer Lösungen – von der Konzeption bis zur Auslieferung – zur Erfüllung spezifischer Kundenanforderungen. 

  • Entwicklung individueller Lösungen wie komplexe Berechnungen (z. B. aus Tarifverträgen zu Urlaubsansprüchen), Erstellung von Dashboards oder Integration externer Systeme. 

  • Analyse von Kundenanforderungen, Erstellung funktionaler Designs und Umsetzung in hochwertige Software. 

  • Behebung von Bugs sowie Implementierung neuer Funktionen als Teil des täglichen Workflows. 


Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir suchen Menschen mit Potenzial und Motivation – nicht nur perfekte Lebensläufe.

  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und Leidenschaft für Technik. 

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master) in Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. 

  • Erfahrung mit objektorientierten Programmiersprachen, idealerweise Java. Kenntnisse in Jmix, SQL, SQLMesh oder RabbitMQ sind von Vorteil. 

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Softwarearchitekturen zu verstehen und weiterzuentwickeln. 

  • Interesse an neuen Technologien und deren praktischer Anwendung. 

  • Du kannst sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team arbeiten. 

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse  

Deine Vorteile bei uns

  • Attraktives fixes Jahresgehalt (ohne variable Anteile):

  • Starke Benefits:

    • 28 Tage Urlaub

    • 1 Tag Homeoffice pro Woche (Hybridmodell)

    • Apple- oder Windows-Laptop – du hast die Wahl

    • Modernes Büro in zentraler Lage am Hackeschen Markt – mit hervorragender ÖPNV-Anbindung und vielen Restaurants & Cafés in der Umgebung

  • Sicherheit & Perspektive: Innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit der Stabilität einer langjährig erfolgreichen Muttergesellschaft

  • Wachstum mitgestalten: Direkter Einfluss auf die Expansion in Deutschland und der Schweiz – und langfristig auch in weitere Branchen

title: Senior Financial Controller
description: Deine Mission Wir suchen einen motivierten und erfahrenen Senior Financial Controller (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Teilzeit (50 %). Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und deine Mission ist es, unsere Controlling-Funktion über alle unsere Gesellschaften hinweg von Grund auf aufzubauen und zu professionalisieren. In dieser Schlüsselrolle übernimmst du die volle Verantwortung für die Gestaltung unseres finanziellen Rückgrats: Du steuerst die Finanzplanung und -analyse, schaffst automatisierte KPI-Transparenz und schlägst die Brücke zwischen operativer Buchhaltung und strategischer Entscheidungsfindung. Darüber hinaus fungierst du als zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren externen Buchhaltungspartnern und sorgst für reibungslose Tagesabläufe und nahtlose Jahresabschlüsse für unsere Beratung. Dein Verantwortungsbereich Controlling-Infrastruktur: Konzeption, Implementierung und Professionalisierung unserer gesamten Controlling- und Reporting-Strukturen von Grund auf. Multi-Entity Management: Steuerung, Abstimmung und Konsolidierung der Finanzprozesse und des Reportings über alle drei Unternehmensgesellschaften (Deutschland, Schweiz und Litauen) hinweg. Dashboarding & Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege automatisierter Dashboards für die wichtigsten KPIs in allen zentralen Geschäftsbereichen, in enger Abstimmung mit dem Management, um eine zeitnahe und regelmäßige Transparenz der Geschäftsentwicklung zu gewährleisten. Strategisches Sparring: Du agierst als vertrauensvoller Berater für das Management und lieferst datengestützten Input für wichtige finanzielle und strategische Entscheidungen. Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Steuerung der täglichen Buchhaltungsaufgaben, einschließlich der Bearbeitung von Rechnungseingängen, des Debitoren-/Kreditorenmanagements und der pünktlichen Ausführung von Zahlungen. Schnittstelle zur Buchhaltung: Du bist der Hauptansprechpartner und koordinierst die reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit unserem externen Buchhaltungsbüro (Steuerberater/Buchhalter). Jahresabschlüsse: Management und Begleitung der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen. Financial Planning & Analysis: Entwicklung umfassender Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Budgetplanungen zur Unterstützung strategischer Entscheidungen. Performance Monitoring: Überwachung von Cashflow, Liquidität und Projektrentabilität in unserem gesamten Beratungsgeschäft Prozessoptimierung: Vorantreiben k ontinuierlicher Verbesserungen im Finanz- und Verwaltungsbereich zur Steigerung von Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit. Dein Profil Nachgewiesene Berufserfahrung (3-5+ Jahre) im Financial Controlling, idealerweise in einer Beratung, Agentur oder einem technologiegetriebenen Umfeld. Ein proaktives, Hands-on-Mindset mit der Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Boutique-Beratungsumfeld sehr eigenverantwortlich und selbstständig zu arbeiten. Fundiertes Verständnis von Rechnungslegungsgrundsätzen (z. B. HGB) und praktische Erfahrung bei der Begleitung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem Multi-Entity-Umfeld. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, kritisches Denken und das Selbstvertrauen, die volle Verantwortung für den Finanzbereich zu übernehmen. Sicherer Umgang mit moderner Finanzsoftware (wir nutzen Finway) sowie fortgeschrittene Excel-Kenntnisse. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch wird vorausgesetzt, kombiniert mit sehr guten Business-Englischkenntnissen. Was wir Dir bieten Die einzigartige Chance, die Controlling-Abteilung eines wachsenden Unternehmens aufzubauen, zu professionalisieren und aktiv mitzugestalten. 100 % Remote-Arbeit, die dir maximale Flexibilität gepaart mit maximaler Eigenverantwortung bietet. Eine reaktionsschnelle Unternehmenskultur, in der Entscheidungen schnell getroffen werden und Hierarchien nicht im Weg stehen. Ein internationales Team, das sich trotz Remote-Kultur mehrmals im Jahr zu gemeinsamen Teamevents trifft. Einen modernen Tech-Stack, ein attraktives Vergütungspaket sowie kontinuierliche Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung. Nicht alle Punkte erfüllt? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir wissen, dass außergewöhnliche Talente viele Facetten haben. Wenn dich diese Rolle begeistert und du zuversichtlich bist, dass deine Erfahrung und Vision einen echten Mehrwert für unser Team bringen – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllt – ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich, dich zu bewerben. raw.description:
Founded in 2009, CLO Virtual Fashion is creating a new ecosystem for digital fashion based on its unrivaled technology in 3D clothing simulation algorithms. CLO Virtual Fashion provides all clothing-related services from concept to design, manufacturing, marketing, fitting, and styling based on 3D clothing simulation algorithms.
Along with costume design software CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny, we are involved in the entire costume journey with platforms specialized in costume content such as CLO-SET and CONNECT to build an efficient and sustainable workflow. Additionally, our solution allows physical and digital garments to be tagged together to function within the CLO system.
 
CLO Virtual Fashion, which is leading the global digital fashion market, currently has a total of 18 offices in 14 countries around the world, including Asia, North America, Europe, and South America, and is gradually expanding based on numerous customers from around the world.
 
 
Position Overview
We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Talent Acquisition Manager to join the People & Culture team and become a foundational partner in securing the best talent for CLO Virtual Fashion—a fast-moving innovator in fashion technology.
 
This role is a pivotal strategic partnership that directly influences our business trajectory and organizational culture. You will be central to designing and executing talent strategies aligned with our ambitious growth objectives, identifying individuals who authentically embody CLO’s values and enhance our unique culture. Furthermore, you will be responsible for driving the HR strategy across the entire European region and actively participating in broader Global initiatives. 
 
To thrive in this challenging mission, we seek a proactive professional who maintains a deep awareness of global recruitment standards, industry trends, and best practices in Human Resources.
 
How to apply
- Submit CV and Cover letter in English (otherwise it won't be considered)

Resume Screening ➡️ 1st interview (w/Global Team members, online, 1 hours) ➡️ Final interview (CEO, online, 45 mins)

  • Act as a Strategic Talent Acquisition and HR Partner, collaborating closely with business leaders and hiring managers in the European regions on role definition, Workforce Planning, and supporting long-term organizational development strategies
  • Defining selection criteria, high profiles, and job specifications for various positions, with a particular focus on roles within the tech and fashion industries, by actively engaging with internal stakeholders.
  • Innovating and executing strategic hiring methodologies aligned with the company's culture and the industry standards.
  • Continuously analyze talent trends, compensation structures, and industry benchmarks within the European market to provide insights that maximize our recruiting competitive edge.
  • Contribute European regional expertise to the development of international HR standards, including global workforce policies, compensation strategy, and benefit plans.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing among global People & Culture teams and proactively introduce the latest HR trends and technologies.
  • Collaborating with the global People & Culture team and the Business team to implement impactful employee-centric initiatives and programs that fit the company

  • 3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or HR, with required expertise in a strategic capacity
  • Direct experience leading the recruitment of various positions within a Tech, IT, or Fast-Paced Industry
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills to effectively collaborate and influence European and Global Leadership teams and internal stakeholders
  • In-depth understanding of labor laws, data protection regulations (including GDPR), and HR compliance in key EU countries including Germany, France, Spain and Italy, ensuring legal adherence throughout the entire HR matters
  • Operational knowledge to design the employee experience ensures a seamless connection with subsequent HR administrative tasks
  • Proficiency with tools such as Google Workspace, MS Office, and Slack
  • Native in German and fluent in English
  • Willing to travel internationally when needed

title: Senior webMethods Integration Engineer (w/m/d) in Teil- oder Vollzeit
description: Unser JobChat Als modernes Unternehmen verzichten wir auf Stino-Stellenanzeigen und möchten dich mit einem neuen Format für die CROZ DACH begeistern. Vielen Dank für dein Interesse an uns und viel Spaß beim Lesen des folgenden JobChats! Neulich in der Teamküche: Joachim : Wir brauchen jemanden, der sich mit webMethods auskennt. Linda : Ich habe bereits eine Stellenanzeige vorbereitet – der Titel lautet Senior webMethods Integration Engineer (f/m/d). Markus : Aber bitte kein Silodenken. Wir suchen jemanden, der den gesamten Integrationslebenszyklus verantwortet: Design, Entwicklung, Release und Betrieb. Wer den Flow entwirft, baut ihn auch, deployt ihn und betreut ihn. Ein echter Generalist. Peter : Konkret bedeutet das: Entwurf von Integrationsflows mit Designer – von einfachen Point-to-Point-Verbindungen bis hin zu komplexen Orchestrierungen. Entwicklung von Services in der webMethods Flow-Sprache (BRANCH, MAP, INVOKE, LOOP, SEQUENCE) und in Java, Aufbau von Adapter-Integrationen (SAP, JDBC, Salesforce & Co.) sowie Implementierung von Datentransformationen mit DTL oder XSLT. Markus : Und danach fängt der eigentliche Spaß an: Releases über CI/CD-Pipelines mit Deployer, Command Central und Tools wie Jenkins oder GitLab CI – über DEV, TEST, UAT und PROD hinweg. Im Betrieb: Monitoring mit My webMethods und Optimize, Incident-Behebung, Performance-Tuning – und Ruhe bewahren, wenn eine Broker-Queue volläuft oder der Thread-Pool erschöpft ist. Joachim : Ein weiteres großes Thema bei unseren Kunden ist die Migration von anderen Integrationsplattformen auf webMethods – zum Beispiel von TIBCO, MuleSoft, Oracle SOA Suite, SAP PI/PO oder hauseigenen ESB-Lösungen. Und die webMethods-Welt steht nicht still: Seit der IBM-Akquisition heißt alles IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration – also ist jemand, der auch mit Containern und Cloud-Integration gearbeitet hat, genau richtig für uns. Peter : Was uns wichtig ist, ist ein solides Fundament: Integrationspatterns wie Request-Reply, Pub/Sub, Dead-Letter-Queues und durchdachtes Fehlerhandling – plus ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie webMethods APIs bereitstellt und konsumiert (REST, SOAP/WSDL). Linda : Und wie viel Erfahrung sollten sie mitbringen? Joachim : Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit webMethods – Integration Server, Broker oder Universal Messaging, Designer. Jemand, der Integrationsprobleme selbstständig lesen, debuggen und beheben kann. Aber ehrlich gesagt: Wenn die Erfahrung nah dran ist, aber nicht exakt, und wer Integrationslösungen wirklich End-to-End durchdenkt, wollen wir trotzdem sprechen. Markus : Als Bonus freuen wir uns über Erfahrung mit dem webMethods API Gateway, webMethods B2B (Trading Networks), Managed File Transfer mit webMethods MFT (ActiveTransfer), Optimize für SLA- und Prozessmonitoring – oder mit LDAP-Integration, SSL/TLS-Setup sowie Clustering und Hochverfügbarkeit im webMethods-Stack. Annabelle : Genauso wichtig wie die Technik: Jemand, der sich mit Ambiguität wohlfühlt und eine vage formulierte Anforderung in eine funktionierende Integration verwandeln kann, der Probleme nicht weitergibt, sondern löst, der klar kommuniziert – auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern – und der von Tag eins an an Logging, Alerting und Recovery denkt. Und da sich unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Zagreb schon auf einen regelmäßigen Austausch freuen, sind sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse wichtig. Peter : Ob das Wissen aus einem Studium, einer Ausbildung oder Jahren in Enterprise-Projekten stammt, ist für uns sekundär. Wichtig ist, dass es vorhanden ist – zusammen mit der Neugier, mit den webMethods-Releases Schritt zu halten. Linda : Super, dann stelle ich die Anzeige online. Wenn das auf Sie zutrifft: Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – und auf ein erstes Gespräch bei einem (virtuellen) Kaffee. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical QA Tester (f/m/d)
description: We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come. Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. Senior Technical QA Tester (f/m/d)  We’re looking for a Senior Technical QA Tester to join the Idle Bank Tycoon team in Berlin. You’ll own the quality of the game end-to-end: from feature testing and test automation to performance profiling and process improvement; embedded in a cross-functional team alongside Product, Game Design, and Engineering. If you enjoy both the technical depth of engineering and the craft of making sure things actually work for real players, this might be the right fit. Responsibilities Own features and test coverage end-to-end, from identifying QA flows and edge cases based on product requirements to release sign-off and post-release monitoring of the game. Design, write, and review test plans and test maps; review submissions from other QA team members and define the QA strategy for complex features. Perform technical QA analysis, when needed, including runtime profiling, memory analysis, CPU/GPU usage, and build size validation on iOS and Android. Monitor and investigate regressions: frame rate drops, load time increases, APK/IPA size changes across builds. Proactively coordinate team playtests and continuously monitor release performance, raising red flags early. Drive continuous improvements to QA process and tooling, partnering with the QA manager on workload and priorities across internal & external testers. Run and maintain automated test suites on our in-house Test Automation Platform, and convert manual test cases into automated tests using the platform. Required Skills Strong hands-on manual QA/testing expertise across the full test lifecycle, ideally in mobile or gaming. Solid understanding of mobile game performance metrics: profiling, memory, build sizes, and frame pacing on iOS and Android. Experience with test management tools (Xray, TestRail, Zephyr or similar) and Agile/Scrum workflows in Jira. Experience coordinating QA workload across internal and external testers. Familiarity with AI-assisted tooling for testing, triage, or workflow automation. Basic Python knowledge, enough to run automated test suites and convert manual tests to automation using our in-house Test Automation Platform. Strong communicator in English (written and verbal) across cross-functional teams. Proactive, ownership-driven, and comfortable making calls in ambiguous situations. Desirable Skills Extensive QA experience in mobile gaming, particularly F2P/LiveOps. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitLab. Familiarity with Unity. Hands-on experience with mobile profiling tools (Xcode Instruments, Android Profiler, or equivalent). Familiarity with Firebase, SDKs, and third-party plugins. Basic SQL and familiarity with data pipelines.   Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability. We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us. We look forward to hearing from you! Your Benefits – We’re game to support you Competitive Salary - We believe that top performers should receive top payment Learning Budget - We believe in learning. A generous personal learning budget to spend on learning and development, including books, workshops and attending conferences. We also offer in-house training such as coding and German classes Flexible Working Hours and Home Office – We believe in a good work-life balance Equipment - State-of-the-art technical equipment, including laptops and phones, which may also be used in your free time Kolicard - We offer you a monthly flexible budget of 50 euros that you can use for a gym membership, transportation, shopping etc. Mobility budget - We offer a monthly budget that will make your commuting to work easier Relocation - Relocation support to help you move to Berlin Pension - Opportunity to save for your pension tax-free Bonus Level – We love to have a good time, too Food and Drinks - Fresh fruits to keep you healthy and fresh coffee to keep you alert. We also have a fully stocked fridge with Smoothies, Coke, Club Mate, beer etc Parties and Team Events - Apart from our regular parties, BBQs and movie nights we also have a team event budget you can use to buy games or sports equipment to make working here even more fun Company Holidays - Every year we go on an amazing company holiday to relax and bond as a team Friday Celebrations - Company-provided dinner and drinks on Friday afternoons Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Project Planner (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) -  Frankfurt/Berlin/Munich (Hybrid)
description: Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry?  Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology?  Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job?  Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry?  Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on.  ____________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects!   If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.   Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Check out our short film about it. ) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)   The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .)   This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it.    ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. )   Core values for a good life   A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:   - Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself  - Care about people – your relationship with others around you  - Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team  - Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world    We enshrined our values in our vision:   We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:   - Connects us with meaningful relationships  - Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans  - Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures    By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.   And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:   - To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation  - To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society  ____________________________________________________________ The Role    Purpose of the role    You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise.    Your team    This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on:   - Understanding what the real problems of projects are  - Implementing the best solutions to those problems  - Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology    More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors.   Your top three objectives    1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection  2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems  3. To develop yourself and everyone around you    Your top five responsibilities    1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially  2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are  3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively  4. Make scalable solutions : Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved  5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well     You must have:   - A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data - Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach  - Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them  - Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact    Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:    - You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge  - You like to be the smartest person in the room  - You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback  - You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions     What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres , infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects . These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .)    Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally.    Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life.    How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry?   You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry.    The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use.    ____________________________________________________________   Benefits   The standard stuff:     - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance  - Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft    The life-changing stuff:   - In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being - Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it - Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins - Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________   Important! Applying properly   We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:   - Why you want to join us  - What you’ll bring to the team    We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix.     This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility. - Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up
____________________________________________________________
 
Important! Applying properly
 
We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
 
- Why you want to join us 
- What you’ll bring to the team 
 
We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. About the Role

Events are an important part of how we build Langdock's community. We host customer dinners, our conference "The Dock", forums, webinars, and other gatherings that bring together people who are shaping the future of work and AI.

As an Events Intern or Working Student, you will support the planning and execution of our events. You will see what it takes to run professional events from the inside - from the first planning document to the last guest leaving the room.

This is a hands-on role with lots of ownership. You will work closely with our marketing team, take responsibility for your own tasks, and learn quickly by doing.

If you are curious about how great events come together, this is your perfect learning opportunity.

 

What You Will Do

  • Support the execution of our conference, customer dinners, forums, team events, and other community activations

  • Help with event planning, timelines, checklists, guest lists, invitations, and registrations

  • Coordinate with venues, caterers, speakers, suppliers, and other external partners

  • Prepare event materials, signage, name badges, welcome packages, and other on-site details

  • Support guest communication before, during, and after events

  • Help create smooth experiences for speakers, customers, prospects, and our team

  • Be on-site during events and help make sure everything runs as planned

  • Take ownership of specific workstreams and bring them to completion

  • Help us document what worked, what did not, and how we can improve future events

 

What Makes This Different

You will not just be observing from the sidelines. You will be involved in real events and trusted with meaningful responsibilities from the beginning.

You will learn how professional events are built: how to turn an idea into a format, how to work with partners, how to manage details under time pressure, and how to create an experience that people remember for the right reasons.

Because we are a small and fast-moving team, you will have direct access to the people making decisions. You can ask questions, suggest ideas, and see the impact of your work quickly.

  • You are curious about events, marketing, community, or communications

  • You enjoy organizing things and keeping track of details

  • You take responsibility and follow through on what you start

  • You are comfortable working on several tasks at once and staying calm when plans change

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in both German and English

  • You are hands-on and happy to help wherever needed - including on-site during events

  • You have a good sense for what makes people feel welcome and looked after

  • You are currently studying or have recently graduated, ideally in event management, marketing, communications, hospitality, business, or a related field

Compensation

This is a paid role.

 

Next Steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Ob Strategy Execution, Organisationsentwicklung oder Skalierung – wir begleiten Führungsteams dabei, ambitionierte Ziele in messbare Erfolge zu verwandeln. Dabei denken wir analytisch, handeln pragmatisch und gestalten Veränderungen, die wirklich greifen. Was Du mitbringst Du bringst mindestens drei Monate an Zeit mit, um Dich optimal in die Projekte einarbeiten zu können. Du begeisterst Dich für Strategieentwicklung, digitale Geschäftsmodelle, verschiedene Industrien, neue Technologien und Innovationen sowie agile Managementmethoden. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Learning-Mindset, arbeitest Dich gerne in neue Themen, Trends und Industrien ein und hast Freude daran, Dein neues Wissen mit Deinen Kolleg:innen und unseren Klient:innen zu teilen. Du bist konzeptionell und analytisch kompetent, Du vertraust gerne auf Zahlen bei der Bewertung von Sachverhalten und legst Wert auf präzise Kommunikation. Du hast einen wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, naturwissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bachelorabschluss von einer Universität von hoher akademischer Exzellenz mit sehr guten Noten. Du beherrschst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch min. auf C1-Niveau. Eine weitere Fremdsprache ist ein Plus. In allen Sprachen kommunizierst Du offen, parkettsicher, verbindlich und humorvoll. Was wir anbieten Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Top-Management unserer Klient:innen – im Mittelstand und in DAX Konzernen genauso wie in Tech-getriebenen und internationalen Scale-ups. title: Shop Manager / E-Commerce Manager (m/w/d)
description: Werkstudent:in, Teilzeit, Minijob oder freie Mitarbeit 5VISION SHOP macht Einsatzfotografie sichtbar: echte Momente aus Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienst, Polizei und anderen Bereichen, festgehalten von Menschen, die nah dran sind. Unsere Motive gibt es in verschiedenen Größen und hochwertigen Ausführungen – vom Poster über Leinwand und gerahmte Bilder bis zu Acrylglas und Metall. Entstanden ist der Shop aus der Nachrichtenagentur 5VISION NEWS und der Idee, die Menschen hinter den Einsätzen und ihre Arbeit wertzuschätzen. Damit aus starken Bildern ein guter Shop wird, suchen wir jemanden, der nicht nur Bestellungen verwaltet, sondern mitdenkt: beim Sortiment, bei Produktseiten, beim Kundenerlebnis und bei allem, was dafür sorgt, dass aus einem Besuch im Shop auch eine Bestellung wird. Aufgaben Du hältst unseren Shop am Laufen, sorgst für saubere Abläufe und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit uns weiter. Du pflegst unser Sortiment, legst neue Motive und Produkte an und hältst Produktdaten, Preise, Varianten und Beschreibungen aktuell. Du bereitest neue Einsatzfotos für den Shop auf: passende Kategorien, Schlagworte, Titel und Texte, die das Motiv verständlich und interessant machen. Du bearbeitest Bestellungen zuverlässig – vom Eingang bis zur Übergabe an Produktion oder Versand. Du bist Ansprechperson für Kund:innen, beantwortest Anfragen freundlich und kümmerst dich lösungsorientiert um Reklamationen. Du prüfst regelmäßig, ob im Shop alles funktioniert: Produktvarianten, Bilder, Preise, Versandinformationen, Gutscheine und Bestellabläufe. Du erkennst, wo Kund:innen abspringen oder Fragen haben könnten, und schlägst konkrete Verbesserungen vor. Du hilfst dabei, Themenwelten, Aktionen, Bestseller oder saisonale Produkte sinnvoll im Shop zu präsentieren. Du arbeitest direkt mit Geschäftsführung, Redaktion und Produktion zusammen – pragmatisch, schnell und ohne unnötige Umwege. Qualifikation Das solltest du mitbringen Du hast idealerweise schon mit einem Shopsystem, Produktdaten oder digitalen Bestellprozessen gearbeitet – oder du arbeitest dich schnell und zuverlässig ein. Erfahrungen mit Shopify sind von großem Vorteil. Du bist sorgfältig: Ein falscher Preis, eine fehlende Variante oder eine unklare Lieferzeit fallen dir auf, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Du kannst klar und freundlich schreiben – auch dann, wenn eine Bestellung mal nicht so läuft wie geplant. Du verstehst, dass ein guter Onlineshop mehr ist als eine Produktliste: Informationen müssen stimmen, Produkte müssen gut aussehen und der Weg zum Kauf muss einfach sein. Du hast ein Auge für Bildauswahl, Struktur und Produktpräsentation. Kenntnisse in Canva und insbesondere Photoshop oder ähnlichen Tools sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest selbstständig, dokumentierst sauber und hältst Zusagen sowie Deadlines ein. Du weißt, dass KI mehr kann als verdächtig professionelle Stellenanzeigen zu schreiben – und setzt sie sinnvoll ein, ohne Produkttexte in austauschbaren Prompt-Brei zu verwandeln. Benefits Das erwartet dich Ein Shop mit echtem, außergewöhnlichem Bildmaterial statt austauschbarer Massenware oder lahmen Dropshipping aus Fernost. Ein Themenfeld mit klarer Community: Menschen aus Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienst, Polizei und Blaulichtumfeld. Raum, den Shop nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern sichtbar mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln. Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und schnelle Entscheidungen. Freie Zeiteinteilung und remote Arbeit. Werkstudent:in, Teilzeit, Minijob oder freie Mitarbeit – wir finden eine Vertragsform, die zu deiner Situation passt. Eine langfristige Perspektive, wenn die Zusammenarbeit passt und du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. Interesse? Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung. Erzähl uns lieber kurz, warum du Lust auf 5VISION SHOP hast, welche Erfahrungen du mit Shops, Produktpflege oder Kund:innenkontakt mitbringst und wie du arbeiten möchtest. Wenn du schon einmal einen Shop gepflegt, Produkte angelegt, Prozesse verbessert oder Content für Produkte erstellt hast: Zeig uns gern Beispiele.   • Write SOLID, maintainable, flexible, testable, and scalable code
  • Design components and integrations within team scope, considering scalability, maintainability, and reliability
  • Lead adoption of better engineering practices and adapt workflows for team efficiency
  • Prioritise and plan tech debt pay-down with the team; drive strategies to reduce recurring debt

  • Support our CI/CD environment and produce a positive impact with each release
  • Support our agile, flexible, team-oriented development to bring the search product to the next level

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or relevant industry experience
  • 7+ years of commercial experience as a Java Engineer
  • Strong experience with Java/JVM-based frameworks such as Micronaut or Spring Boot
  • Solution-oriented attitude with a focus on materializing the business vision through technical means
  • Experience with k8s and AWS
  • Experience with database management systems such as MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Solid experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka or others)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch

Mehr als 200 envelianer:innen mit über 20 verschiedenen Nationalitäten sind bereits an Bord. Komm dazu und wachse mit uns! Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Market Intelligence unterstützt du unsere Teams International Expansion und Commercial beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren Market-Intelligence-Frameworks. Du verbindest ein Interesse an kommerziellen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen mit einer datengetriebenen Denkweise und hast Freude daran, in komplexen und sich schnell verändernden Umfeldern für Klarheit zu sorgen. Wie du etwas bewirkst Du baust unser internes Market-Intelligence-Framework weiter aus und hältst es aktuell, einschließlich: regelmäßiges Scouting von Marktentwicklungen und Trends in relevanten Ländern detaillierte Analysen von länderspezifischen Regulierungen und Markttreibern strukturiertes Monitoring der Markt- und Branchenlandschaft (z. B. relevante Akteure, Initiativen, Partnerschaften und News) gezielte Nutzung von internem Wissen (z. B. Learnings aus Sales, Customer Success und Product) Du hältst unsere internen Datenbanken, die das Market-Intelligence-Framework unterstützen, aktuell und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität (Struktur, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz). Du entwickelst unser Market-Intelligence- und Analytics-Framework weiter, indem du zur Prozessautomatisierungbeiträgst und zusätzliche Datenquellen integrierst, sofern dies sinnvoll und umsetzbar ist. Du unterstützt das Team mit strukturierten Research-Ergebnissen (z. B. Markt-Snapshots, Kurzanalysen und Zusammenfassungen zur Entscheidungsfindung) und sorgst für eine klare Dokumentation. Dein Profil Du studierst aktuell im Bachelor oder Master (z. B. BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Data & Analytics, Politikwissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang). description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer on our Enterprise team, your role is to guide some of Germany's largest businesses to the frontier of AI and help them deploy Claude into their operations, their products, and their ways of working. You will become the go-to Claude Platform specialist and trusted technical advisor for your customers, advising their engineering teams on architecture, agent design, and evaluation, and working with the C-level and senior executives who sponsor these programmes to show the business value Claude can create and help them reach a confident decision to build on Claude.</p> <p>Enterprise deals are different. Procurement cycles are longer, more stakeholders are involved, and success depends on being able to connect the technical work to the outcomes the boardroom cares about. You will be as comfortable advising an engineering team on evaluation and architecture as you are presenting a value case to a CIO or CTO, and you will carry the technical thread across every stage of a multi-quarter engagement. Much of this work happens in German, with German executives and engineering teams, so native or fluent German is essential for the role.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives and Applied AI Architects to take each customer from first conversation, through technical evaluation, proof of value and procurement, to the decision to build on Claude. Once they have decided, you set their systems integration partner up to deliver, agreeing the target architecture and what good looks like, and you stay close as the customer's technical advisor on Claude throughout deployment, while the partner does the build. Working alongside Anthropic's Product and Engineering teams, you will use your knowledge of the Claude Platform to advise on evaluation, recommend architectures that meet enterprise security and scale requirements, and create the technical and business resources that help large organisations succeed with Claude.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Account Executives and Applied AI Architects to take enterprise customers in Germany from first conversation, through technical evaluation, proof of value and procurement, to the decision to build on Claude</li> <li>Lead the technical side of each opportunity through to that decision, and remain the customer's technical advisor on Claude as they deploy</li> <li>Set customers and their systems integration partners up to deliver: agree the target architecture, define what good looks like, and stay on hand to advise the delivery team as the build progresses</li> <li>Guide enterprise customers to the frontier of AI, advising them on how to deploy Claude into their operations, their products, and their ways of working</li> <li>Help customer engineering teams see how they would build on Claude, covering architecture, agent design and evaluation, so they can make a confident decision</li> <li>Build and present the business value case for Claude with C-level and senior executives, in German and English, linking technical capabilities to measurable outcomes such as cost, revenue, risk, and time to market</li> <li>Guide customers through long, multi-stakeholder procurement and adoption cycles, including technical evaluations, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, and a clear path to production</li> <li>Work with Account Executives on account strategy, deal qualification, and executive engagement plans, and with Applied AI Architects to keep context and continuity across every engagement</li> <li>Run executive briefings, technical workshops, and enablement sessions for both leadership and engineering audiences</li> <li>Navigate enterprise requirements around security, compliance, data residency, and governance, working with Anthropic's internal teams where needed</li> <li>Identify patterns across enterprise engagements and feed insights back to Product, Engineering, and the wider Applied AI team</li> <li>Travel to customer sites across Germany for executive meetings, workshops, and relationship building</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Native or fluent German, written and spoken, as you will work day to day with German enterprise customers at both executive and engineering level</li> <li>6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder</li> <li>Experience in a pre-sales or technical advisory role selling into large enterprises, ideally in the German market, including scoping and designing complex solutions</li> <li>Experience with value-based selling, meaning you can build a business case, quantify impact, and present it to senior decision makers</li> <li>Comfort presenting to, and building relationships with, C-level and VP-level stakeholders</li> <li>Experience owning the technical win in enterprise deals: evaluations, proofs of concept and technical due diligence with engineering, security, legal and procurement teams</li> <li>Production experience with LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale</li> <li>A hands-on engineering background, including building and deploying production applications, so you can relate to engineering leaders and their teams</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and architecture requirements, and experience working through them with customer teams</li> <li>The ability to explain complex AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences, and to move between industries such as financial services, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing</li> <li>A passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: What is Leapsome? Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams . Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike. Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone , and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement. Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market. It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work! Your Opportunity We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own the creative engine behind our paid social growth. This role is for someone who lives and breathes creative. You'll lead the research, briefing, testing, and iteration that drives performance on Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and you'll think about every creative decision in terms of the business outcome it delivers, not just what looks good. You're a rare blend of creative and technical: you have genuine taste, and you can execute. That means writing the hook, briefing the edit, or cutting the ad yourself when speed matters more than process. You'll partner closely with the Performance Marketing team to scale paid social into a channel that's driven by creative insight rather than just campaign setup, and to help define Leapsome's creative voice as we continue scaling globally. What you will do: Creative Strategy & Positioning Develop the positioning, messaging, and creative angles that make HR and People leaders feel understood rather than marketed to. Find the moments, frustrations, goals, and everyday realities that resonate with real HR practitioners. Translate product and platform experiences into concepts that stop the scroll and drive action. Stay close to the customer: watch competitor ads, read comments, study reviews, and let those insights inform every creative decision. Turn performance data and testing results into sharper creative strategy by identifying what's working, what isn't, and what to try next. Creative Production Own creative across static image, video/B-roll, and partnership/UGC ads. Lead concepting, briefing, and sign-off end to end. Write the copy that anchors the work: hooks, scripts, on-screen text, static copy, and end cards across video and static formats. Recut and remix existing ads quickly to generate high-volume creative iterations, and cut/produce ads yourself when speed matters more than process. Run creator operations end to end: sourcing, contracting, and whitelisting for UGC and partnership creators. Build a steady pipeline of high-performing creative across categories, with a clear test-and-learn cycle behind every concept. Paid Social Strategy & Media Buying Independently own and operate paid social accounts day to day across Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube. This includes campaign builds, audience/targeting setup, budget allocation, bid strategy, and QA. Make media buying and creative decisions through an ROI lens, tying output to cost per conversion, conversion rate, and pipeline impact, not just creative quality. Manage and forecast paid social budgets in partnership with the Performance Marketing team. Collaborate closely with Growth, Product Marketing, and Design to keep creative aligned with broader campaign strategy. Who are we looking for? 3+ years in a performance marketing or creative strategy role, with hands-on ownership of paid social creative and campaign management. A track record you can point to: you led a creative strategy that drove a measurable lift in conversions or sign-ups and moved cost per conversion in the right direction. Obsessed with the customer. You think about who you're talking to before you think about what you want to say. Hands-on experience editing video (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar). Experience running creator operations end-to-end (sourcing, briefing, contracting, whitelisting) is a strong plus. Familiarity with AI creative tools (e.g., Midjourney, Higgsfield, AdCreative.ai , or similar) is a strong plus. Comfort working with performance data (Meta/LinkedIn/YouTube Ads Manager, GA4 or equivalent) to inform creative decisions, not just intuition. Strong project management and communication skills. You can run multiple creative workflows and reviews at once without losing quality control. Quick to pick up new tools: AI creative platforms, editing software, growth analytics. Experience with creative analytics platforms (e.g. Motion) is a plus. Working familiarity with paid search platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads). You'll occasionally pitch in on paid search tasks alongside our freelance paid search support. Benefits Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform. Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace. Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth. Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network. Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical. Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness. Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays. Impact: Join a fast-growing HR platform trusted by more than 2,000 companies worldwide: you'll help shape how companies run HR and grow their people in one connected system. Culture: A diverse, international team that values open feedback and celebrates wins, big and small. Sponsored lunch: Lunch is on us every Tuesday and Thursday. Work from anywhere: Work from a different location for up to 2 months a year. Monthly team activities: Join Feierabend , a monthly budget to get-together in Berlin — hosted by employees, for employees. This role is based in Berlin and the salary range for this position is €80,000 - €100,000 + Bonus + Equity . View our full compensation framework here . Leapsome aims to pay generously and fairly. If the listed range isn’t working for your situation, please tell us early in the process, we’d rather have that conversation than lose a great candidate over a number we may be able to address. If your role or skillset isn’t covered in our compensation framework , it’s likely because we haven’t hired enough in that area yet. We’ll build a data-backed range before we make you an offer, and we’ll share our thinking with you as early as we can. This note is published for transparency. It reflects our compensation philosophy as of June 2026 and describes our general global approach — it is not a contract, offer, or entitlement to any salary, increase, or bonus, and may change at any time. Individual compensation is always governed solely by your written employment agreement and applicable local law. Leapsome’s values We stay true to our values in everything we do at Leapsome. Impact is everything — We aim high, focus on the outcomes that matter and say no to the rest. Speed is our advantage — We move fast with intent — simplifying, automating, and learning as we go. Owners without egos — We trust owners and expect excellence in return. We take responsibility individually, support each other, and win as a team. Candid is kind — We speak up early and respectfully. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Help us make work fulfilling for everyone! At Leapsome, we want work to be the best it can be for everyone. We help companies create environments where people can achieve shared goals, build authentic relationships, learn, and grow together. Put simply; our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone. And we know how to get there. But we can only do this by “walking our talk” and building a diverse and inclusive company where people — not just the business — thrive.
